CustomField.label: Dimension Key
CustomField.description: The machine key the answer travels under and the key stored in Section_Scores__c / Estate_Complexity_Dimensions__c, e.g. estate_scale. Must match one of GtmAssessmentScoring.DIMENSIONS (Readiness) or GtmEstateComplexity.DIMENSIONS (Complexity): the Apex list is the allowlist the scorer trusts, so a key added here alone is collected but scores nothing. Wording is editable here without a developer; the set of keys is not.
